svg.title: The same app, shipped as one binary
svg.desc: No launcher. The app bundles its own UI with just the modules it needs and starts the core itself. Identical module set, identical contract surface — what changes is who owns the event loop and who supplies the QML host. A user who wants only Muster never meets Basecamp.

g.text: its own UI + just the modules it needs
logos runtime — subprocess isolation, capability-scoped calls
sees that a transfer happened, and when
whatever the chosen rail disclosed, forever
